input.question: Why is it that I hear about people in the past dying of the common cold while I'm able to beat the common cold with no medication and/or major symptoms?
input.ground_truth: You probably have a balanced diet and aren't missing any nutrients. You also probably have a warm home and don't work in the fields every day. Bottom line, our lives are less stressful and we have better food than our ancestors.

Question: Why is it that I hear about people in the past dying of the common cold while I'm able to beat the common cold with no medication and/or major symptoms?

response.prediction:
Okay! Let’s imagine the common cold is like a little sneezy monster.

A long, long time ago, people didn’t have all the same things we have now to help them. For example, they didn’t have warm houses, good food, or medicines like we do. When the sneezy monster (the cold) came to visit, their bodies weren’t as strong, so the monster could make them really sick—even make them very, very sick, sometimes even too sick to get better.

But now, we have:
- Cozy homes that keep us warm.
- Good food that helps us grow strong.
- Our bodies get used to the sneezy monster, so they can fight it better.
- Sometimes, we have medicines or vitamins to help, too.

That’s why you can beat the cold easily and don’t get very sick, but people long ago got much sicker from the same sneezy monster!
